notes.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide announced - now open for Pre-Order!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/a5968f18b9af02a8386f30b1f8078c09a3464012.jpg

SpongeBob and Patrick Tackle Their Ghostliest Adventure Yet in SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide

Swap between the iconic duo on the fly as you uncover supernatural secrets in this spooky, splashy 3D platformer
 
Munich, Germany / Vienna, Austria - August 1st, 2025: Are you ready, kids? THQ Nordic and developer Purple Lamp are thrilled to announce SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide, a new single-player 3D platforming adventure within the SpongeBob SquarePants franchise coming to PC, PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2™ on November 18th, 2025. 

Pre-Purchase & Wishlist Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479650

Check out the announcement trailer: https://youtu.be/B_DRlBipcHY
Website: https://spongebobtitans.thqnordic.com

Prepare to be scared – in the most nautical nonsense kind of way!
When the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune’s egos collide, the result is pure undersea chaos: spectral mayhem spreads across Bikini Bottom, and only two brave(ish) heroes can set things right. SpongeBob and Patrick must team up, combine their unique skills, and (hopefully) stop the total ghostification of their world. From the depths of Neptune’s Palace to the icy peaks of Mount Bikini, fans will explore iconic locations, face epic bosses, and first and foremost: have F.U.N!

Pre-Order & Digital Editions
Pre-orders are now live! The PC pre-orders are coming with a 10 % pre-order discount and include the Natural Costume Pack DLC as a free bonus.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/c65c54a62b3c72c1a96f2d6c1c8867683b4299e1.jpg

 Standard Edition: Base game
 Ghostly Digital Edition on PC: Base game + Tidal Season Pass + Soundtrack

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/824f4cd4fdeb73aac5ddbd9eaa6c6304ef3a9960.jpg

About SpongeBob SquarePants
Since its launch July 17, 1999, SpongeBob SquarePants has generated a universe of beloved characters, pop culture catchphrases and memes, theatrical releases, consumer products, a Tony award-winning Broadway musical and a global fan base. SpongeBob SquarePants is one of the most widely distributed properties in Paramount history, seen in more than 180 markets, translated in 30+ languages, and averaging more than 90 million total viewers every quarter. SpongeBob SquarePants was created by Stephen Hillenburg and produced by Nickelodeon in Burbank, Calif.  The character-driven cartoon chronicles the nautical and sometimes nonsensical adventures of SpongeBob, an incurable optimist and earnest sea sponge, and his undersea friends.

Enjoy & stay tuned!

notes.title: Spongetastic 3D-Platformer The Cosmic Shake Is Available Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/24422481962c98a62be8dbcceb2574ae567467ab.jpg

Spongetastic 3D-Platformer The Cosmic Shake Is Available Now!
 
Vienna, Austria, January 31st, 2023: We interrupt whatever it is you're doing for a Bikini Bottom special news report! Recent reports from our fish on the ground have described the scene as wild, claiming that the news “SpongeBob SquarePants – The Cosmic Shake is now available” has thrown Bikini Bottom into disarray: Innocent citizens and beloved landmarks have disappeared into strange, magical portals! 

Officials are asking the population to stay calm and have come out with an official statement: "Notorious Bikini Bottom residents SpongeBob and Patrick are on the case!" Of course, this leads us to several questions:


 Will our heroes brave the many dangers of the fantastical WishWorlds?
 Will they rescue their friends and bring them home safely?
 Will fancy moves and even fancier costumes prevail?!
 And will the Chum Bucket serve something edible for a change?


To our friends SpongeBob and Patrick, all this announcer fish has to say is: anchors aweigh, brave heroes, Bikini Bottom is counting on you!

If you want to learn more, check our footage directly from the scene: 

Watch the SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake Launch Trailer on YouTube: https://youtu.be/KVpremaIEwI

SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake is now available on PC, PlayStation®4, Xbox One™, and Nintendo Switch™. The game is available at an SRP of € 39.99 / $ 39.99 / £ 34.99. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282150/

Enjoy & stay tuned

notes.title: This is The Cosmic Shake: New SpongeBob Game to Launch January 31st 2023!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/24422481962c98a62be8dbcceb2574ae567467ab.jpg

This is The Cosmic Shake: New SpongeBob Game to Launch January 31st 2023 - Pre-Order Starts Now
 
Vienna/Austria, December 6th, 2022: Mermaid tears, bubbles, and wishes are all part of a cosmic adventure that awaits you in SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake! Every adventurer needs the right gear and in Cosmic Shake you're in for a treat: pre-order the game now, either digitally or physically at participating retailers, and receive the Costume Pack for free! This includes 7 iconic costumes, such as RoboBob SteelPants, Mermaid Man Bob, and Opposite Day.

The Costume Pack will also be available for purchase on launch day.

Watch the new Trailer on YouTube: https://youtu.be/8s4b2e8g73g

Pre-Order SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake!
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake is ready for pre-order now, at an SRP of € 39.99 / $ 39.99 / £ 34.99. When pre-ordered, the game will include the Costume Pack for free. The Costume Pack will also be available for purchase at an SRP of € 9.99 / $ 9.99 on launch day.

Included in the Costume Pack:

 RoboBob SteelPants
 Mermaid Man Bob
 JellyBob
 Primitive Sponge
 Dried Sponge
 Opposite Day
 Band Geek


Preorder now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282150/SpongeBob_Schwammkopf_The_Cosmic_Shake/

Website: https://cosmicshake.thqnordic.com

SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake is in development for Nintendo Switch™, PC, PlayStation®4, and Xbox One and will be out January 31st, 2023.

Since its launch in July 17, 1999, SpongeBob SquarePants has reigned as the most-watched animated series for 22 consecutive years, while generating a universe of beloved characters, pop culture catchphrases and memes, theatrical releases, consumer products, a Tony award-winning Broadway musical and a global fan base. SpongeBob SquarePants is one of the most widely distributed properties in Paramount International history, seen in more than 170 countries, translated in 29+ languages, and averaging more than 100 million total viewers every quarter. SpongeBob SquarePants was created by Stephen Hillenburg and produced by Nickelodeon in Burbank, Calif. The character-driven cartoon chronicles the nautical and sometimes nonsensical adventures of SpongeBob, an incurable optimistic and earnest sea sponge, and his undersea friends.
	
Are you ready, kids?
